## DEXSeq Analysis - GSE173955

```{r}
library(DEXSeq)
library(tidyverse)
library(BiocParallel)

BPPARAM_GSE173955 <- MulticoreParam(workers = 4)
out_dir_GSE173955 <- file.path("results", "DEXSeqGSE173955")
dir.create(out_dir_GSE173955, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# prepare count matrix and sample metadata
count_matrix_GSE173955 <- round(as.matrix(isoform_counts_GSE173955))

sample_data_GSE173955 <- data.frame(
  row.names = colnames(count_matrix_GSE173955),
  sample = colnames(count_matrix_GSE173955),
  condition = metadata_GSE173955$condition
  # Add confounders here if available
)

# Convert design variables explicitly to factors 
factor_cols_GSE173955 <- intersect(c("sample", "condition", "sex", "batch"), colnames(sample_data_GSE173955))
sample_data_GSE173955[factor_cols_GSE173955] <- lapply(sample_data_GSE173955[factor_cols_GSE173955], factor)
sample_data_GSE173955$condition <- relevel(sample_data_GSE173955$condition, ref = "Control")
```

```{r}
# align transcript-to-gene annotation and filter features
tx2gene_GSE173955 <- tx2gene_df_GSE173955 |> 
  dplyr::filter(transcript_id %in% rownames(count_matrix_GSE173955)) |> 
  dplyr::arrange(match(transcript_id, rownames(count_matrix_GSE173955)))

# Keep only multi-isoform genes
multi_iso_genes_GSE173955 <- tx2gene_GSE173955 |> 
  dplyr::count(gene_id) |> 
  dplyr::filter(n >= 2) |> 
  dplyr::pull(gene_id)

keep_tx_GSE173955 <- tx2gene_GSE173955$gene_id %in% multi_iso_genes_GSE173955
count_matrix_GSE173955 <- count_matrix_GSE173955[keep_tx_GSE173955, ]
tx2gene_GSE173955 <- tx2gene_GSE173955[keep_tx_GSE173955, ]

# Filter low-count isoforms
keep_expr_GSE173955 <- rowSums(count_matrix_GSE173955 >= 10) >= 3
count_matrix_GSE173955 <- count_matrix_GSE173955[keep_expr_GSE173955, ]
tx2gene_GSE173955 <- tx2gene_GSE173955[keep_expr_GSE173955, ]
```

```{r}
# build object
dxd_GSE173955 <- DEXSeqDataSet(
  countData = count_matrix_GSE173955,
  sampleData = sample_data_GSE173955,
  design = ~ sample + exon + condition:exon,
  featureID = tx2gene_GSE173955$transcript_id,
  groupID = tx2gene_GSE173955$gene_id
)
```

```{r}
# run DEXSeq pipeline
dxd_GSE173955 <- estimateSizeFactors(dxd_GSE173955)
dxd_GSE173955 <- estimateDispersions(dxd_GSE173955, BPPARAM = BPPARAM_GSE173955)

# Note: If confounders are added to design, specify both fullModel and reducedModel here:
# fullModel = ~ sample + exon + condition:exon + sex:exon,
# reducedModel = ~ sample + exon + sex:exon
# according to the exercise in the class

dxd_GSE173955 <- testForDEU(
  dxd_GSE173955,
  fullModel = ~ sample + exon + condition:exon,
  reducedModel = ~ sample + exon,
  BPPARAM = BPPARAM_GSE173955
)

dxd_GSE173955 <- estimateExonFoldChanges(dxd_GSE173955, fitExpToVar = "condition", BPPARAM = BPPARAM_GSE173955)
dxr_GSE173955 <- DEXSeqResults(dxd_GSE173955)
```

```{r}
# extract isoform-level and collapsed gene-level results
alpha_GSE173955 <- 0.05

# Isoform-level table
res_isoforms_GSE173955 <- as.data.frame(dxr_GSE173955) |> 
  tibble::as_tibble() |> 
  dplyr::arrange(padj)

sig_isoforms_GSE173955 <- res_isoforms_GSE173955 |> 
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(padj), padj < alpha_GSE173955)

# Automatically detect log2fold column name
lfc_col_GSE173955 <- grep("^log2fold_", colnames(res_isoforms_GSE173955), value = TRUE)[1]

# Collapse to gene-level keeping the most significant isoform per gene (preserves stat & log2FC for fgsea)
res_genes_GSE173955 <- res_isoforms_GSE173955 |> 
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(stat)) |> 
  dplyr::select(
    gene_id = groupID,
    isoform_id = featureID,
    stat,
    log2FC = dplyr::all_of(lfc_col_GSE173955),
    pvalue,
    padj
  ) |> 
  dplyr::group_by(gene_id) |> 
  dplyr::slice_min(order_by = pvalue, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |> 
  dplyr::ungroup() |> 
  dplyr::mutate(padj = p.adjust(pvalue, method = "fdr")) |> 
  dplyr::arrange(padj)

sig_genes_GSE173955 <- res_genes_GSE173955 |> 
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(padj), padj < alpha_GSE173955)

# Summary counts
cat("Significant isoforms (FDR < 0.05):", nrow(sig_isoforms_GSE173955), "\n")
cat("Unique genes from significant isoforms:", length(unique(sig_isoforms_GSE173955$groupID)), "\n")
cat("Significant genes after gene-level FDR:", nrow(sig_genes_GSE173955), "\n")

# Save results to results/DEXSeqGSE173955
readr::write_csv(res_isoforms_GSE173955, file.path(out_dir_GSE173955, "DEXSeq_all_isoforms_GSE173955.csv"))
readr::write_csv(sig_isoforms_GSE173955, file.path(out_dir_GSE173955, "DEXSeq_sig_isoforms_GSE173955.csv"))
readr::write_csv(res_genes_GSE173955, file.path(out_dir_GSE173955, "DEXSeq_all_genes_GSE173955.csv"))
readr::write_csv(sig_genes_GSE173955, file.path(out_dir_GSE173955, "DEXSeq_sig_genes_GSE173955.csv"))
saveRDS(dxr_GSE173955, file.path(out_dir_GSE173955, "dxr_GSE173955.rds"))
```

```{r}
# Inspect top 10 significant genes
head(res_genes_GSE173955, 10)
```

## Graphs and Analysis

```{r}
# 1. Dispersion estimation plot
plotDispEsts(dxd_GSE173955, main = "DEXSeq - Dispersion Estimation (GSE173955)")
```

```{r}
# 2. MA plot
plotMA(dxr_GSE173955, cex = 0.8, alpha = 0.05, main = "MA Plot - Differential Isoform Usage (GSE173955)")
```

```{r}
# 3. Volcano plot
volcano_df_GSE173955 <- res_isoforms_GSE173955 |> 
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(padj), !is.na(.data[[lfc_col_GSE173955]])) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    sig = dplyr::case_when(
      padj < 0.05 & .data[[lfc_col_GSE173955]] > 1  ~ "Up (padj < 0.05 & |LFC| > 1)",
      padj < 0.05 & .data[[lfc_col_GSE173955]] < -1 ~ "Down (padj < 0.05 & |LFC| > 1)",
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"
    )
  )

volcano_plot_GSE173955 <- ggplot(volcano_df_GSE173955, aes(x = .data[[lfc_col_GSE173955]], y = -log10(padj), color = sig)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Up (padj < 0.05 & |LFC| > 1)" = "#D55E00",
    "Down (padj < 0.05 & |LFC| > 1)" = "#0072B2",
    "Not significant" = "grey75"
  )) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  labs(
    title = "Differential Isoform Usage - GSE173955",
    x = paste0("Log2 Fold Change (", lfc_col_GSE173955, ")"),
    y = "-Log10 Adjusted P-value",
    color = "State"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

volcano_plot_GSE173955
ggsave(file.path(out_dir_GSE173955, "volcano_plot_GSE173955.png"), plot = volcano_plot_GSE173955, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
# 4. Per-gene fraction of significant isoforms histogram (Optional challenge #3 in exercise)
per_gene_frac_GSE173955 <- res_isoforms_GSE173955 |> 
  dplyr::transmute(
    gene_id = groupID,
    isoform_id = featureID,
    sig = !is.na(padj) & padj < alpha_GSE173955
  ) |> 
  dplyr::group_by(gene_id) |> 
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_iso = dplyr::n(),
    n_sig = sum(sig),
    frac_sig = n_sig / n_iso
  ) |> 
  dplyr::ungroup() |> 
  dplyr::filter(frac_sig > 0)

frac_plot_GSE173955 <- ggplot(per_gene_frac_GSE173955, aes(x = frac_sig)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "#009E73", color = "white") +
  labs(
    title = "DEXSeq: Per-Gene Fraction of Significant Isoforms (GSE173955)",
    x = "Fraction of significant isoforms per gene",
    y = "Number of genes"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

frac_plot_GSE173955
ggsave(file.path(out_dir_GSE173955, "per_gene_isoform_fraction_GSE173955.png"), plot = frac_plot_GSE173955, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
# 5. Isoform switching profile for the top significant gene

plotDEXSeq(
```
